title: When the Orbit Burns Revisited
author: Freya Sandoval
blurb: Ines Ishikawa, a decommissioned war android paying off its debts, has spent twenty years hauling cargo through contested orbits. Then the colony's children start sharing the same dream — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must decide which half of humanity wakes from cryosleep, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
